title: koeleria pyramidata
intro: Koeleria pyramidata, commonly known as June grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria pyramidata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
